stem:
Four fraction models are shown.

Model 1, Model 2, Model 3, Model 4

Which two models are shaded to show equivalent fractions?
visual_elements: Four rectangles labeled Model 1 through Model 4. Model 1 is divided into 3 vertical sections with 2 shaded. Model 2 is divided into 4 sections by 2 vertical and 1 horizontal line arranged 2 by 2 with 3 of 4 sections shaded. Model 3 is divided into 3 vertical sections with 1 shaded (the middle one). Model 4 is divided into 4 equal sections by a vertical and horizontal line; 3 of 4 sections are shaded.
difficulty_rationale: Requires recognizing and comparing fractions from visual models and identifying equivalent fractions, involving conceptual understanding beyond direct recall.
